  • Partner with the managers, directors and technical leaders of our organization to elevate our architecture practices to the next level;

More about you

  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;

A Swarovski Crystal Business tem alcance global com aproximadamente 2.400 lojas e 6.700 pontos de vendas em cerca de 140 países e emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas. Um lugar onde qualquer pessoa se sinta parte da empresa. Todos os aspectos do emprego, incluindo a decisão de contratar, promover, disciplinar ou demitir, serão baseados no mérito, competência, desempenho e necessidades do negócio. Não discriminamos com base em raça, cor, religião, estado civil, idade, nacionalidade, deficiência física ou mental, condição médica, gravidez, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero ou qualquer outro status protegido por lei nos países onde operamos.

Job description

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso a saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e para fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 5Hubsoperacionais nas regiões Sul eSudeste,compondo uma rede com9 hospitais, mais de 1.300 leitos, 7.500 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

  • Modelar dados e manter dashboards em Power BI com aplicação de RLS por unidade, convênio e médico.

  • Realizar análises de glosas, taxas de aprovação e OPME comparado a gabaritos.
  • Desenvolver camadas em SQL/Databricks integradas ao modelo semântico no Power BI.
  • Garantir qualidade, governança e performance das soluções (DAX avançado, Incremental Refresh, Composite Models).
  • Conduzir o fechamento mensal e preparar apresentações executivas com storytelling e ponte de margem.

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharias, Estatística ou Computação.

  • Necessário conhecimento em Storytelling com dados, comunicação executiva e capacidade de influenciar áreas comerciais e assistenciais.
  • Imprescindível conhecimento intermediário/avançado em Power BI e Excel;

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Overview

About Sierra Studio

When you apply to Sierra, you join an ecosystem. We specialize in connecting talented Brazilian professionals with exciting career opportunities in a highly-vetted small community of growing companies in the US. Applying to Sierra seamlessly integrates you into this ecosystem, granting automatic eligibility for all relevant opportunities we offer.

About our hiring partner

Our hiring partner is a consumer product development company. They help companies make new products & bring them to market, leading concepting, design, engineering, supply chain setup & ongoing operational oversight. They have teams in New York City, Hong Kong and beyond. They work with startups and established companies across many consumer categories; from connected hardware & electronics, to durable housewares and in-home goods, to soft-goods and packaging, and everything in between.

Who our hiring partner is looking for

They are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join their team. This position will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling, prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer will be a member of our hiring partner's Brazil team - The position can be remote but will report to the Staff Engineer out of Campinas/SP. The Brazil team reports into the Head of Product based in HQ in NYC.

The Candidate

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the concept to manufacturing journey. You've either built or supported bringing new products to the world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of materials. You're willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on challenges.

The Job

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

Responsibilities

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.e. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components. Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

The Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE's.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • High level proficiency in English language- written and spoken

Working Hours

While our work involves coordination predominantly with NY Team, there are meetings that are scheduled outside of traditional 9-6 working hours to accommodate the HK team. We trust all team members to manage their schedules and to take appropriate measures to take care of themselves and their wellbeing.

The Process

Please submit your resume and we will reach out if there is a potential fit.

Our hiring partner is constantly refining their hiring process to be as inclusive, transparent, and respectful of applicants' time as possible. As part of this process, you may be asked to complete a paid assessment based on the role.

Our hiring partner is an equal opportunity employer. They are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. They firmly believe that a diversity of experience, perspectives, and background lead to a better environment for their employees and to better results for their clients. They strongly encourage diverse candidates to apply.

Toradex’s Brazil office hosts parts of the Global Sales, Marketing, and R&D teams, composed of several engineers working on diverse tasks with global reach. As an Embedded System Developer in the Developer Experience team, you will work to accelerate the time-to-market of our customers through the provision of technical support, the production of technical documentation, and the creation of demonstrations and proofs-of-concept.   • Programming languages

  • An agile and inter-cultural work environment
  • Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment
  • Participation in defining processes and your working environment
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
  • Opportunities for your personal development

Toradex is providing and dynamic, fun and exciting work environment. We are looking for somebody who has similar values, is passionate about his work, and is motivated to learn new things. We try to constantly improve and expect the same from you.

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

A partir disso, geramos dados precisos sobre o conhecimento dos alunos, e ajudamos as instituições de ensino na transformação da gestão pedagógica.

Sobre a Vaga

Acompanhar escolas parceiras desde o fechamento do contrato para garantir que saibam trabalhar com todas as soluções contratadas, oferecendo treinamentos, palestras e formações voltadas para gestores, professores, alunos e famílias. Além disso, verificar os resultados gerados nas avaliações e auxiliar essas escolas na leitura dos dados. Ao mesmo tempo, desenvolver estratégias para aumento do engajamento.

Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. Description

As an Embedded Linux Software Development Engineer BSP, you are part of the R&D team, making sure our Linux BSPs and related software offerings for our SoMs (System on Modules) are constantly developed, maintained, and quality improved. The work ranges from initial bring-up, to driver and kernel development, up to build-system, tooling and distro level development.

  • Communicate your work progress, coordinate with other development teams, and participate in R&D working groups

Skills

  • Expertise in Embedded Linux: Bootloader and Linux Kernel
  • Excellent C language knowledge and programming skills
  • Knowing OpenEmbedded/Yocto Project build system
  • Knowledge of industry standard interfaces and protocols such as I2C , SPI , UART , USB, Ethernet, PCI Express
  • C++/Python/Bash language knowledge and programming skills
  • Demonstrable Electronics knowledge and work experience: the ability to read and understand hardware schematics and datasheets; to use standard development aids such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, bus protocol analyzers, etc. when developing low-level software which interacts directly with machine registers
  • Familiar with communication peripherals (Bluetooth, Ethernet, Wi-Fi)
  • High-integrity, open, team player

Plus but NOT MANDATORY:

  • Experience with Real Time Operating systems
  • Knowledge of the ARM architecture

What do we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and inter-cultural corporate culture.
  • Flexible working set up. Working remotely possible (within European time zone)
  • Work on the latest HW technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our HW and SW offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced HW and SW engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Todradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Lead Accountant (Brazil) - SQM Iodine & Plant Nutrition

SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition, a global mining and chemical company, has a worldwide leadership position in the markets in which we are present, which is possible thanks to the strategic location of our operations in northern Chile, from where we have access to high-value resources, in addition to our network of commercial offices that allows us to reach more than 100 countries with our products.

Every day we are inspired by our purpose: “we develop unique capabilities that transform resources into life and progress” , achieving the highest quality products that generate value to strategic industries such as health, technology and food.

This is a great opportunity for talented people who can develop as a Accounting Lead for our office in Campinas, Brazil.

YOUR MISSION

Oversee and coordinate the company's administrative and financial activities, ensuring the efficient use of resources, compliance with accounting, tax, and legal obligations, and the generation of reliable information for decision-making. The objective is to guarantee financial stability, operational efficiency, and adequate support for other areas of the organization.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Bank Management

  • Receive, review, and process invoice payments.
  • Monitor cash balances based on the Company's cash flow needs.
  • Prepare bank reconciliations.

Third-Party Management

  • Keep customer and supplier master data up to date.
  • Request third-party assessments through the Compliance platform.

Credit and Commercial Control

  • Review and release customer orders in accordance with commercial risk policies.
  • Request credit line approvals from the insurer and internal managers, depending on the amount of exposure.
  • Request credit line extensions from the insurer when necessary.
  • Control and monitor customer credit lines.

Inventory Management

  • Perform the monthly closing of the inventory module.
  • Participate in the physical inventory control committees (quarterly).
  • Record adjustments resulting from physical inventory counts (when applicable).

Fixed Assets and Leases (IFRS 16)

  • Control recorded fixed assets.
  • Manage and monitor lease agreements in accordance with IFRS 16.
  • Review monthly depreciation of fixed assets and leases.

Payroll Management

  • Calculate sales commissions payable to the sales department.
  • Review payroll processed by the accounting outsourcing company.
  • Review monthly balances to be accounted for related to health, parafiscal contributions, and social benefits.

General Accounting

  • Provide support for the proper recording of accounting transactions.
  • Validate exchange rate controls on a quarterly basis.
  • Coordinate the closing and opening of accounting periods.
  • Manage accounting structures and taxes.
  • Send the monthly closing schedule to the relevant areas.

Other Routine Activities

  • Respond to and follow up on requests from the Statutory Auditor and external advisors.
  • Respond to requests from Corporate Audit.
  • Monitor and follow up on internal control.
  • Provide administrative support in response to requests from other areas, the Finance Manager, or other corporate management.
  • Analyze and communicate transfer pricing adjustments, when applicable.
  • Request supplier approvals in accordance with compliance criteria.
  • Manage expense reports on the Rydoo platform.
  • Prepare employment certificates.
  • Fill out forms for supplier registration.
  • Follow up on requirements from control entities.
  • Attend to legal procedures that apply to the company.

O seu dia a dia:

  • Executar análise avançada de dados (advanced analytics/ data science) utilizando conceitos de big data, para gerar insights para as áreas de negócio do grupo CPFL;
  • Avaliar, propor e implementar metodologias estatística, de inteligência artificial e machine learning, avaliando o contexto, prazo de entrega e dados disponíveis;
  • Liderar projetos de análise de dados com outras áreas para ganhos operacionais nas diversas unidades de negócio, construindo relacionamento com outras áreas, buscando oportunidades, subsídios para compreensão do escopo de trabalho e entendimento das regras envolvidas no negócio.

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços .

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso praticamos ações afirmativas em que reservamos vagas para aumentar cada vez mais a representatividade de grupos sociais minorizados, como por exemplo, mulheres, pessoas com deficiência e pessoas negras. If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES
- 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
- Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
- Proven ability of build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
- Experience in building subscription based products with a track record of driving growth;
- Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
- A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep understanding of gaming trends;
- Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform how food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We are partnering with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing fast. Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We are proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil where the real climate impact happens.

About The Role

Role: COO to lead go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors, and to evolve our operational backbone. You will oversee the entire value chain—from mineral inputs and field operations to the internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

Location & Travel: Hybrid, with travel in Brazil. Language skills: Portuguese, English (fluent). Start date: Ideally Q3/Q4 2025.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to national impact in agriculture and mining; a 1-100 leadership role requiring bold strategy and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil with scalability in mind.
  • Translate carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement via operational KPIs, systemisation, and data-driven performance.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Impact Officer, Head of Operations, and VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and operational goals.
  • Lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling to ensure product-market fit.
  • Build cross-functional alignment to ensure the product offers agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements; orchestrate the 1-100 scale-up journey.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm; ensure compliance with carbon standards and farmer requirements.
  • Support legal to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
  • Lead a large and growing team across Brazil and globally; collaborate with Carbon, Science, and Technology teams and strategic partners.

Team & Culture

  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable; turn high performers into high-impact owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You have scaled something from messy beginnings to market success—ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic—able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our mission to address climate change.
  • Compensation: Competitive compensation philosophy discussed in the first interview to manage expectations fairly.
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget; Hybrid Remote around Sao Paulo.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil.
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)

How To Apply

description:
Aeroporto de Viracopos (VCP)!
Responsibilities and assignments

Job Description
Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️
A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.
Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.
O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.
Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Viracopos (VCP)!
Responsibilities and assignments

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.
Requirements And Qualifications
  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E.
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
Additional information
Estamos sempre em busca de novos talentos, então faça o seu cadastro e venha fazer parte do time dnata Brasil!
Líder mundial em fornecer serviços aéreos!
Junta-se a nós e venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no Brasil. Supervisor de Suporte

Mais do que solucionar os problemas de empreendedores, queremos que eles se apaixonem por nós. E manter esse relacionamento é a principal responsabilidade do time de suporte. Na Superlógica, acreditamos que oferecer suporte vai além de resolver problemas: queremos que nossos clientes se apaixonem pela nossa plataforma . Nosso time de suporte é peça-chave nessa jornada – cuidando, orientando e garantindo uma experiência excepcional .

Se você tem paixão por pessoas, aprende rápido, é organizado, gosta de trabalhar com dados e está sempre em busca de melhorias, essa vaga pode ser para você!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  1. Gerenciar as filas de atendimento: priorizar demandas, distribuir cargas de trabalho e acompanhar chamados críticos com follow-ups consistentes;
  2. Acompanhar e desenvolver o time: orientar tecnicamente os analistas, promover treinamentos e garantir crescimento técnico e comportamental;
  3. Analisar KPIs individuais: como TMA, qualidade, CSAT e SLA, promovendo ações de melhoria contínua;
  4. Investigar chamados críticos e CSATs negativos: identificar falhas e implementar planos de ação corretivos e preventivos;
  5. Garantir padronização no atendimento: desde a primeira resposta até o transbordo para níveis superiores;
  6. Atuar como suporte tático ao time: apoio em escalas, produtividade e dúvidas operacionais;
  7. Antecipar e corrigir desvios operacionais: garantindo a excelência no atendimento;
  8. Colaborar com áreas parceiras: para eliminar gargalos e otimizar fluxos;
  9. Reportar resultados da equipe: por meio de relatórios de desempenho e análise de indicadores.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  1. Experiência anterior com liderança de times de suporte técnico ou atendimento;
  2. Vivência em gestão de filas e alocação de tarefas;
  3. Domínio em análise de KPIs e indicadores de performance de suporte;
  4. Excel intermediário/avançado para análises e relatórios;
  5. Comunicação clara, foco em resultados e orientação para processos;
  6. Ensino superior completo.

Fazendo parte do time, você terá “SuperBenefícios” como:

  • Flexibilidade de horário: Podemos sempre nos adaptar às mudanças do dia a dia, o importante mesmo é sempre alcançar o objetivo.
  • Ajuda de custo para os dias em home office: A gente dá o suporte necessário para que você possa trabalhar no conforto do seu lar, em dias de home office.
  • Ifood Benefícios Flexíveis (VA + VR): Transformar o mundo dá uma fome, né?! E é claro que o nosso recheado VA e VR não podem ficar de fora dessa missão.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico: A saúde sempre em primeiro lugar, para você e seus dependentes.
  • Apoio aos pais: Se tornar mãe ou pai é algo espetacular, e queremos participar deste grande momento com você. Por isso, além do auxílio creche, temos também licença-parental (maternidade e paternidade) estendida.
  • Saúde e Bem-estar: Parceria com o Gympass e auxílio farmácia.
  • Treinamentos e educação: Temos parcerias com escolas e universidades e oferecemos treinamentos EaD gratuitos.
  • Ambiente que valoriza feedbacks 1:1.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Key Account Manager role at BotCity

BotCity is a pioneering hyperautomation platform backed by notable investors including Y Combinator and Softbank. Specializing in RPA and AI, we provide advanced governance, orchestration, and developer tools to enable enterprises to scale their automation initiatives effectively. With a philosophy that automation projects are software projects, we advocate a high-code approach, primarily using Python. Serving over 1,000 companies across 73 countries, BotCity has established a strong global presence with implementation partners worldwide. In 2024, we were celebrated on G2.com as one of the world\'s top 25 emerging platforms alongside industry giants like MidJourney, WhatsApp Business, and Slack. Recognized by Endeavor as a ScaleUp in 2023, and growing at a double-digit monthly rate, our dynamic teams are located across Brazil, the US, and Europe.

Overview

The Key Account Manager is in charge of building and maintaining strong long-term relationships with key clients, ensuring their satisfaction and driving mutual business growth through strategic account management.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the sales process with BotCity high-value clients, including presentations, product demonstrations and negotiations.
  • Develop and implement strategic account plans to penetrate and expand the sales base.
  • Build and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, understanding customers\' needs and providing tailored solutions to meet their objectives.
  • Track industry trends, market conditions, and the competitive landscape to identify new business opportunities.
  • Provide market feedback to the Product and Marketing teams to enhance the company’s offerings and market positioning.
  • Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to network and promote the brand.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all sales activities and interactions in the CRM system.
  • Contribute to BotCity\'s Strategic Plan by providing insights on Enterprise customers and market trends.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients, ensuring their satisfaction and driving mutual business growth.
  • Develop deep, trust-based relationships that lead to joint business planning, innovation opportunities and competitive advantages.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree or equivalent experience in Technology, Business, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Account Management or Enterprise sales with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Experience in software sales in the RPA, Intelligent Automation, or iPaaS industry.
  • Demonstrated success in selling complex solutions to large accounts and managing high-value client relationships.
  • Goal-oriented with strong negotiation, persuasion, and influencing skills to engage with senior executives.
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, including collaborating with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think strategically.
  • Strong work ethic and ability to work autonomously.
  • Proficient with tools such as Hubspot, Apollo, Sales Navigator.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Fluent English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with global accounts and managing sales cycles with clients involving multiple stakeholders across different regions.
  • Knowledge of specific industry verticals (especially but not limited to finance, technology) and their unique business challenges.
  • Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth, and fast-paced startup environment.

title: Upstream Bioprocess Scale-up Engineer Specialist
description:
Overview

Braskem, a global leader in the production of bio-based materials, is committed to reducing the carbon intensity of its products through development of technology utilizing bio-based feedstocks. In addition to its existing biotechnology research center in Campinas, Brazil, Braskem has recently opened a new renewable research and development facility in Lexington, MA. These two state-of-the-art facilities bring together scientists and engineers from a variety of disciplines to ideate and develop novel technologies for the production of bio-based chemicals and materials.

Role Description

Braskem Innovation and Technology is seeking an exceptional upstream bioprocess engineer for to scale-up of emerging technologies in the area of bio-based chemicals via fermentation processes. The candidate will work closely with the fermentation development team and have primary responsibility for commercial process design, ensuring technical risks are addressed and mitigated in the scale-up from lab to pilot/demo phases. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in fermentation scale-up with experience in implementation of new technology at industrial scale and comfort working closely with innovative teams from research and development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Synthesize the upstream conceptual process design for fermentation-based technologies emerging from discovery teams in lab. This includes all steps from feed preparation, seed train, and fermentation sections of the flowsheet.
  • Work closely with the fermentation development team to guide experimental work with a view toward the commercial process design, and ensure relevant technical targets are set based on commercial process economics.
  • Guide the planning of the pilot plant testing program according to the conceptualized commercial design to ensure the key risks are mapped and mitigate as the technology progresses through scale-up.
  • Build strong relationships while working closely with the firms operating or constructing the pilot plant fermentation units.
  • Generate the technology transfer package in collaboration with the fermentation development team for upstream section of the bioprocess. Serve as the fermentation process expert during pilot and demo testing, being present onsite for extended campaigns.
  • Support process safety reviews for emerging technologies.
  • Own responsibility as the expert on the process technology and key deliverables of the Process Design Package PDP that will be the basis for commercial design and engineering or toll manufacturing.

Additional Responsibilities and Activities

  • Identify and evaluate innovative and disruptive technologies through interaction with technology licensors, participation in events associated with bio-based chemical technologies, and review of international publications.
  • Carry out techno-economic assessments, actively participating in the preparation and/or technical review of mass and energy balances, PFDs, Capex and Opex estimates, among others.
  • Work with different teams within Braskem (eg process engineering, biotech and catalysis, sustainability, innovation, intellectual property, etc.) to guarantee the successful development of projects.
  • Collaborate with universities, start-ups and technology hubs seeking new technologies that may be of interest to Braskem.

Requirements

  • B S in Chemical Engineering or relevant field (PhD is a plus) with a strong background in new technology development
  • 10+ years (including graduate research) experience in bioprocess engineering
  • Demonstrated experience in process development and scale-up for fermentation technology with implementation of new technology at industrial scale
  • Demonstrated expertise using process simulation software (eg SuperPro or Aspen Plus)
  • Experience in pilot plant and/or demo plant operations
  • Experience with microbial, aseptic aerobic fermentation in stainless steel SIP fermenters
  • Strong technical judgement to assess project decisions and timetables
  • Ability and seniority to ensure good interpersonal relationships and people management, to work on projects with internal and external interfaces
  • Have a working knowledge of intellectual property
  • English and Portuguese fluency is required

Location: Hybrid mode with a home site of Campinas, Brazil to ensure a close working relationship with research teams at the Braskem Tech Centers.

Job details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Engineering and Information Technology
  • Industries: Plastics Manufacturing

Sobre a ODONTOCLINIC

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Tudo isso é possível porque temos um time incrível por trás de cada resultado.

Somos a primeira rede de franquias odontológicas do país e, ao longo dos anos, já recebemos reconhecimentos como o Troféu Excelência em Franchising da ABF e como uma das Melhores Franquias do Brasil pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios. Também fomos eleitos, por seis anos consecutivos, como a clínica com o melhor atendimento do Brasil no segmento odontológico pelo Reclame Aqui.

Aqui, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento de pessoas é o caminho para construir resultados sustentáveis. Investimos constantemente em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

A Odontoclinic oferece um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, vem ser Odontocliniquer!

Líder na exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul, a Minerva Foods é mais do que uma empresa global – somos uma comunidade de profissionais com o propósito de seguir "criando conexões entre pessoas, alimentos e natureza". Na Minerva Foods, sustentabilidade não é apenas um compromisso – é parte do nosso DNA. Com iniciativas robustas de rastreabilidade, contribuímos para um futuro mais sustentável e transparente.

Nosso impacto global é sustentado por 46 unidades industriais, 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais. Esses pilares nos permitem entregar produtos saudáveis e nutritivos para clientes em todo o mundo.

O conhecimento no setor de mercearia é essencial para esta oportunidade, considerando que será a principal pasta de trabalho. Profissionais com experiência no segmento de varejo possuem grande diferencial.

Principais Atribuições

  • Receber requisições de compras;
  • Executar processos de cotação;
  • Concretizar compras de serviços, produtos e matérias-primas;
  • Acompanhar fluxo de armazenamento e distribuição;
  • Realizar atendimento a fornecedores;
  • Supervisionar equipe e processos de compras;
  • Acompanhar conferência física de produtos da mercearia em estoque;
  • Desenvolver negociação com fornecedores, buscando melhores condições de preço, verba, bonificação e margem;
  • Controlar índice de ruptura e corte dos pedidos diariamente;

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência na função de comprador;

Requisitos Desejáveis (diferencial)

  • Conhecimento e experiência no segmento de varejo;
  • Comprometimento com metas e resultados do setor;
  • Liderança e gestão de pessoas;

Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Telemedicina e telepsicologia;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Clube de vantagens;
  • Descontos em farmácias;
  • Cartão convênio;
  • Programas de premiação;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Assistência funeral;
  • Acompanhamento de gestantes;
  • Sala de amamentação, vestiário e sala de descanso;
  • Vale refeição;
  • Plano de carreira;

Jornada De Trabalho e Carga Horária
Escala 6x1, de segunda a sábado.

title: COMPRADOR EXTERNO
description:
Profissional responsável por adquirir materiais recicláveis, negociando com fornecedores, empresas de coleta seletiva e outros parceiros, com o objetivo de garantir a oferta contínua de matéria-prima para empresas que atuam no setor de reciclagem.

Pesquisa de fornecedores: Identificar, avaliar e selecionar fornecedores de materiais recicláveis, como papel, plástico, metais, entre outros.

Negociação: Negociar preços, prazos e condições de compra dos materiais recicláveis, buscando sempre as melhores condições de custo-benefício.

Gestão de estoque: Monitorar e controlar o stoque de materiais recicláveis para garantir o abastecimento contínuo da produção.

Controle de qualidade: Avaliar a qualidade dos materiais adquiridos, garantindo que atendam às especificações e normas da empresa.

Documentação: Gerenciar toda a documentação relativa à compra de materiais, como notas fiscais, contratos e autorizações.

Parcerias: Estabelecer e manter boas relações com fornecedores e parceiros do setor de reciclagem, a fim de criar redes de fornecimento estáveis e sustentáveis.

Análise de mercado: Acompanhar tendências e variações de preço no mercado de recicláveis para realizar compras estratégicas.

Sustentabilidade: Garantir que as práticas de compra estejam alinhadas com os princípios de sustentabilidade e responsabilidade ambiental.
